journal: Transitional regime read from macro: 10Y at 4.68% (+5bp 1d, +50bp YTD), Fear/Greed 60 GREED with mixed component ratings (Momentum Greed, Breadth Fear). Energy sector confirming trend on XLE while tech/growth (QQQ, SMH) pull back -- classic rotation. Bought XLE 33sh as the trend-confirmed name, SPY 2sh as a small core/beta starter given SPY itself is range-bound. Wash-sales tab is brand new to me: empty state on a fresh ledger reads well -- explicitly states deferred vs disallowed are never summed, and is explicit that this is a calculation not tax advice. Noted a WinError 5 file-lock message on the macro page (XLB bars.meta.json) -- looks environmental, will watch if it recurs. Fear and Greed component table Score column is still empty for every row, matching known finding fear-greed-component-score-column-always-empty.

XLE and SPY both pulled back slightly today (-1.4% and flat) but XLE remains above all three MAs, trend intact. Added a deliberate 1-share QQQ rule-probe at 676.57, disclosed as a test vehicle for the wash-sales tab rather than a trend call -- QQQ fails my two-timeframe confirmation (below sma20 and sma50). Plan: harvest this at a loss and repurchase within 30 days later this week to open a real wash-sale window I can inspect on /wash-sales and /tax before the run ends. Equity 9961.37, down 0.39% since inception, roughly tracking a flat tape.

Closed the QQQ rule-probe at a small loss: sold 1 share at 675.17 gross, 0.02 fee, cash_delta 675.15 -- realized loss on cost basis 676.57 is -1.42 net of the fee. book_after shows settled_cash unchanged at 5904.35 and the new unsettled bucket at exactly 675.15 (balance 6579.50 minus settled 5904.35), matching the net cash_delta rather than the gross 675.17 proceeds -- this is the correct behavior for cash-settled-unsettled-split-fee-misattributed, will confirm against the UI and file a re-test. Broader tape is risk-off: SMH -16.2% 20d, QQQ -6.71% 20d. XLE still holding its trend (20d +7.45%) despite a soft couple of days, held. No new entries -- plan to repurchase QQQ next session to open a real wash-sale window before the run ends.

Rebought 1 QQQ at 675.10 -- inside the 30-day window from the session-3 loss sale, deliberately, to trigger a real wash sale on the new /wash-sales tab. Market bounced hard off yesterdays lows (QQQ filled well above the prior close). XLE and SPY both recovered too, equity back above 10k at 10017.01. SPY closed 729.46 yesterday, below my 745.07 sma50 invalidation level but not yet at my 725 stop -- watching closely, one more close like that and I exit. Broad tape action this week has been a genuine risk-off wobble in tech (SMH -23% 20d) with energy the lone holdout, which is exactly the sector-rotation regime read from session 1 playing out.

Final session, no new trades. SPY dipped below its sma50 mid-week (729.46 on 07-29) but bounced back to 741.69/747.03, never touching my 725 stop -- invalidation not triggered, held. XLE was the trend call of the week and it held up the whole time (20d momentum +10-12% throughout), ending the week at 59.55, comfortably above all three MAs. QQQ, opened purely as a wash-sale test vehicle, closed the week up on the bounce (687.99 vs 676.50 tolled cost basis) -- an accidental profit on what was meant to be a tax-mechanics probe. Equity 10051.60, +0.52% since inception vs SPY roughly flat to slightly positive over the same window. Wash-sales tab verdict for the week: legible, reconstructible across five different renderings of the same 1.40 dollar figure (top tile, expanded card, tax summary, wash-sale table, 8949, and portfolio cost basis), and the pre-trigger zero-disallowed state read as a genuine actionable warning rather than an empty row -- it changed my plan for the week, I deliberately timed the repurchase to see the disallowance latch. The one thing I could not test: whether open windows are ordered by urgency, since my ledger only ever produced one open-window symbol -- and whether the closed-window branch still shows the safe-from date, since window_is_open is computed on the real 2026-08-17 clock and my window (safe 2026-08-29) never got there during the replay. Also found a real defect this week: the standalone FEE ledger row on my QQQ sale (-0.02 dollars) is never subtracted in the tax and wash-sale math -- proceeds, gain/loss, the wash-sale deferred amount, and the replacement lot cost basis all use 1.40 where the true economic loss is 1.42, even though portfolio settled/unsettled cash split does account for the same fee correctly. Filed separately.
